suzuki_faq.title: Suzuki FAQ: choosing melodion for kindergarten and primary school
suzuki_faq.scope: Suzuki recommends 32-key alto models when school does not specify a model. This is manufacturer guidance, not national mandate.

distinctions: Melodika already existed under the keyboard family and is enriched rather than redeclared.
32-key alto is a common school route in Suzuki guidance, not a universal mandate.
P-32D and M-32C are peer school instruments, not ranked universally.
Melodica may be cross-linked from free-reed education while its primary parent remains klavishnye.
Stock in ONTOS.RENT is not claimed.
